question: APT vs SUI: larger % price change on July 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
QUESTION: Which of Aptos (APT) or Sui (SUI) had the larger percentage price change on July 21, 2026, according to CoinGecko's daily historical data?

SETTLEMENT RULES:
1. For each token, compute the daily percentage change for July 21, 2026 as: (closing price on July 21, 2026 minus closing price on July 20, 2026) divided by closing price on July 20, 2026, times 100. Use CoinGecko's daily closing prices.
2. The winning outcome is the coin with the larger (more positive) percentage change. This holds even if both changes are negative — the coin that fell less wins.

DATA SOURCES: CoinGecko Aptos Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/aptos/historical_data); CoinGecko Sui Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/sui/historical_data)

POSSIBLE OUTCOMES — select one outcome exactly:
Aptos (APT)
Sui (SUI)
